_comment: What this instance tracks. Copy to project.json and edit. Only jira.project is required; every other value shown here is the default, so delete any line you do not need to change. Epics are optional: leave one blank and the feature that uses it simply shows nothing.

epics._comment: Issue keys. Defects raised in the app are created under 'defects'.

schedule._comment: endDate drives the 'are we on track?' banner in the summary email; leave it blank to hide the banner.

emails._comment: Attachments are files in config/attachments/, sent with every tester email.
